questions.q: Wearing a helmet on an electric scooter is ___ in this city — without one, you can get a fine.
questions.explainRo: Dacă primești amendă fără cască, purtarea ei este obligatorie → mandatory.

questions.q: In this museum, visitors ___ touch the paintings — it's against the rules.
questions.explainRo: Este o interdicție (e împotriva regulilor) → mustn't.

questions.q: The client still hasn't answered my offer. I'll ___ on Monday and ask if she has any questions.
questions.explainRo: „follow up” = a reveni cu un mesaj după o discuție sau o ofertă.

questions.q: Breakfast is included in the price, but you ___ eat at the hotel — there's a lovely café next door.
questions.explainRo: Nu e obligatoriu, poți alege altceva → don't have to (mustn't ar însemna că e interzis).

questions.q: Radu says he built a whole CRM in one weekend. That ___ be true — it's at least two months of work.
questions.explainRo: Suntem aproape siguri că NU e adevărat → can't (nu mustn't).

questions.q: Before every meeting, I read the ___ — the list of topics we're going to discuss.
answers: agenda
questions.explainRo: „agenda” = ordinea de zi, lista subiectelor de discutat la ședință.

questions.q: Would you mind ___ (wait) here for a few minutes? The doctor is still with a patient.
answers: waiting
questions.explainRo: După „Would you mind” verbul are forma -ing → waiting.

questions.q: When I was a kid, I ___ (not / be allowed) to play video games on school nights.
answers: wasn't allowed
was not allowed
questions.explainRo: Pentru permisiune în trecut folosim was/were allowed to; la negativ: wasn't allowed to.
Cerem voie politicos cu „Do you mind if I + verb?”.

questions.ro: Sigur s-a rătăcit șoferul nostru de taxi.
questions.explainRo: Deducție aproape sigură despre prezent: must + be (fără „to”).

questions.audio: You shouldn't send confidential files by email.
answers: You shouldn't send confidential files by email.
You should not send confidential files by email.
You shouldn't send confidential files by e-mail.
You should not send confidential files by e-mail.
questions.ro: Nu ar trebui să trimiți fișiere confidențiale pe e-mail.
questions.explainRo: „shouldn't” + verb fără „to” = sfat: nu ar trebui.

questions.ro: Ați putea să-mi explicați din nou această cerință?
answers: Could you explain this requirement again?
Could you please explain this requirement again?
Could you explain this requirement again, please?
Could you explain this requirement to me again?
Could you please explain this requirement to me again?
Could you explain this requirement to me again, please?
Can you explain this requirement again?
Can you please explain this requirement again?
Can you explain this requirement again, please?
Can you explain this requirement to me again?
Can you please explain this requirement to me again?
Can you explain this requirement to me again, please?
Would you mind explaining this requirement again?
Would you mind explaining this requirement to me again?
questions.explainRo: Rugămintea politicoasă: Could you + verb (fără „to”, nu „explain me”); „cerință” = requirement.
